connectors.name: HiAnimeTV (BETA - Testing only)
connectors.releaseNotes: Candidate 1.0.2 requires Aroki 2.0.4+ to leverage Apple's dedicated AVURLAssetHTTPUserAgentKey for GoogleVideo (Blogger) playback. GoogleVideo signs User-Agent in eaua tokens; version 2.0.4 preserves this header natively on iOS. Note: titles defaulting to encrypted MegaPlay (e.g. My Melody) or dead MegaVid embeds (e.g. 100 Meters) do not provide direct mp4 links and fail stream resolution natively. Live playback on physical iOS devices remains unverified until tested with Aroki build 17+.
